abilities.description: You begin with 3xp that you may spend right now, to either buy another starting asset or upgrade an asset. Add +1 whenever using your species as a means to manipulate an Imperial (who are known to be biased towards Humans). Whenever you @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.05909d6310d209a6]{Make a Connection} or @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.8704c945023355fb]{Test Your Relationship}, add +1. If you roll a strong hit with a match when you @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.985a5415860a99e9]{Fulfill Your Vow}, mark 1 extra tick on your Quests Legacy Track.
